## Safety First

Use fictional data only. Do not include real task titles, calendar titles, attendees, locations, customer data, provider IDs, screenshots, exports, logs, or private workspace details.

## Constraint

Describe the scheduling rule.

## Type

- [ ] Hard constraint
- [ ] Soft constraint
- [ ] Score term
- [ ] Explanation-only signal

## Example

Use fictional tasks, calendars, owners, tenants, workspaces, and times.

## Expected Result

What should a valid schedule do?

## Failure Mode

What should ScheduleOS report when the constraint cannot be satisfied?
